clips.title: The story
paras: Thunder Falls lies in Elwynn Forest’s northwestern heights, where bandits have taken a riverside cottage.

Thunder Falls cuts through the ridges above Mirror Lake, where a mountain stream rushes between steep cliffs. It enters over an unreachable cascade in the north, then spills away in waterfalls on both sides. One fall empties into Mirror Lake; the stream’s downstream course runs west toward Westfall’s rugged border. A cottage, dock, and outdoor forge sit beside the water. Bandits now claim the clearing.
